answer: Attested Summit Quota: each identity gets a hard daily action ceiling set by a slow-moving reputation score, and crossing a new score threshold requires an on-chain attestation from three pre-existing, high-score identities that each spend one of their limited endorsements. An attacker cloning identities hits the ceiling quickly; lifting each clone to useful volume costs three scarce endorsements plus the forgone output of real accounts, making every marginal clone net negative. The visible tundra of low-score accounts reveals farming; a persistent horizon of pending attestations delays scale.
